messages:
maya (marketing): ran a quick spike sim for the webinar signups (1.5k/min for 2m). saw ~6% fallthrough to default owner and a couple of dupes in SF. notes in the campaign runbook.

elliot (ops): 6% is higher than our 2% target. enrichment timeouts?

maya (marketing): enrichment vendor median 900ms, 95p 1.6s. our claim TTL is 1.0s in the webhook consumer for speed.

sara (growth): so TTL < vendor 95p -> race to fallback. two quick ideas: raise TTL during campaign windows or route to a warm pool instead of default owner.

noah (sales-ops): warm-pool sounds best for volume events. SDRs can triage. also add dedupe on enrichment callback to avoid duplicate leads when enrichment returns after fallback.

elliot (ops): proposed shortfix: 
- campaign.metadata.high_volume = true on webinar templates
- soft_hold_ms = 300 when enrichment_queue_depth > 30
- warm_pool_owner = "campaign-warm-inbound"
- bump enrichment_ttl to 1.4s during flagged campaigns

sara (growth): i can enable the flag on the next webinar. will update campaign template.

elliot (ops): action: PR to change claim worker behavior + instrument enrichment_queue_depth metric + feature flag. will canary deploy to staging.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by elliot tag: inbound-warmpool-2026-03-23. rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m canary windows. health check = fallthrough_rate < 2%

maya (marketing): please add a dashboard widget for "fallthrough % by campaign" and a runbook step: "if fallthrough > 2% during event -> enable warm pool + increase TTL to 1.6s".

noah (sales-ops): PR for SF rule: IF campaign.metadata.high_volume = true THEN owner = campaign-warm-inbound ELSE normal_rr(). I'll add dedupe rules.

everyone: thanks — let's sync tomorrow AM if staging metrics aren't green. :thumbsup:
